name: Validate Redis Container
description: Validate Redis Docker container configuration (service health, connectivity, basic operations)

task_steps.description: Check Redis container status (running, healthy, uptime)

prompt.template:
Check the Docker container status for Redis:

1. Run: docker ps --filter name=redis --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.State}}'
2. Check logs: docker logs redis --tail 30
3. Report:
   - Container state (running/stopped)
   - Health status
   - Uptime duration
   - Recent log entries
   - Any startup errors

Provide a clear status summary.

task_steps.description: Verify Redis server is running and responding

prompt.template:
Verify Redis server is operational:

1. Run: docker exec redis redis-cli ping
2. Run: docker exec redis redis-cli info server | head -20
3. Check:
   - PING response (PONG expected)
   - Server version
   - Server mode (standalone/cluster)
   - Uptime
4. Report:
   - Server status (running/stopped)
   - Redis version
   - Server mode
   - Uptime
   - Any errors

Provide Redis server verification summary.

task_steps.description: Verify Redis network accessibility from other containers

prompt.template:
Verify network connectivity to Redis:

1. Check Docker network: docker network inspect metabob-network | grep redis
2. Test from API server: docker exec api-server ping -c 2 redis || echo "Redis unreachable from API"
3. Test port: docker exec api-server nc -zv redis 6379 || echo "Port 6379 unreachable"
4. Report:
   - Network name
   - Accessibility from API server
   - Port 6379 status
   - Any network issues

Provide network connectivity summary.

Test Redis basic operations:

1. SET test: docker exec redis redis-cli SET test_key "validation_test"
2. GET test: docker exec redis redis-cli GET test_key
3. DEL test: docker exec redis redis-cli DEL test_key
4. Check memory: docker exec redis redis-cli info memory | grep used_memory_human
5. Report:
   - SET operation status
   - GET operation status (value retrieved)
   - DEL operation status
   - Memory usage
   - Any errors

Provide Redis operations test summary.

Check Redis configuration:

1. Run: docker exec redis redis-cli CONFIG GET maxmemory
2. Run: docker exec redis redis-cli CONFIG GET maxmemory-policy
3. Run: docker exec redis redis-cli CONFIG GET databases
4. Report:
   - Max memory setting
   - Eviction policy
   - Number of databases
   - Any configuration warnings

Provide Redis configuration summary.

Generate validation report for Redis container:

Summarize all validation results:
1. Container Status: [running/stopped, healthy/unhealthy]
2. Redis Server: [version, mode, uptime]
3. Network Connectivity: [accessible/unreachable from API]
4. Basic Operations: [SET/GET/DEL status]
5. Configuration: [maxmemory, eviction policy]

Overall Assessment:
- ✅ PASS: All checks successful
- ⚠️ WARNING: Minor issues found
- ❌ FAIL: Critical issues found

Recommendations:
- List any required fixes
- Suggest improvements

Create report file: test-results/redis-container-validation.md
